changes: CAEL 0.4.1 adds conversation upgrades on top of the 0.4.0 core engines; a website worker can run a separately selected version.

Exact conversation skills: quantities with transfers, rates and what-if follow-ups, clock times with delays, syllogisms and their converse, weekly schedules, changed values, short notes and tone rewrites.
Chat memory answers questions about what the user said earlier in the conversation and acknowledges new details.
When CAEL does not know, it can search the web and answers only when a second independent publisher agrees.
Indexed rule-graph propagation, sparse validated world transitions and finite-domain ordering replace earlier core algorithms.
A new non-neural local transition learner infers bounded discrete updates from explicit examples.
Live references are traversed iteratively; retrieval honours requested neighbour counts and deterministic ties.
capabilities: Execute supported exact arithmetic, rule, state, ordering and bounded Python tasks.
Infer finite local discrete transitions from explicit input/output examples, reporting empirical guesses and ambiguity.
Retain supported context from the supplied conversation while isolating independent requests.
limitations: In a self-judged 20-conversation comparison CAEL scored about 796 Elo against Qwen3.5-0.8B fixed at 1000 (3 wins, 14 losses, 3 ties); it is not a general chatbot breakthrough.
Web answers often decline when two sources do not agree, and some follow-ups are still missed.
Finite readers still miss wording and complete context; no general chatbot or Qwen superiority is established.
An inferred local transition is a hypothesis, not proof of a unique general rule.
Inherited weights, protected solvers, image CA kernels and the 0.3.7 public resource bundle are unchanged.
evidence: Maintainer evaluation on 60 fresh authored positive core cases: 60/60 versus 12/60 for 0.3.9.1, with known-family/adaptive authoring limitations. On all 2,000 official CellARC test tasks, aggregate cell accuracy is 57.31% interpolation and 34.94% extrapolation; entire puzzles correct are 79/1000 and 5/1000. The exact frozen checkpoint and every prediction were reproduced through the unmodified official symbolic harness. This is not an accepted leaderboard rank, a general-chat claim or a Qwen win.
